mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.poster_image AS posterImage, e.title, e.subtitle, g.name AS galleryName, e.type FROM exhibition e LEFT JOIN gallery g ON e.gallery_id = g.id WHERE e.is_hot = 1 AND e.start_date <= CURDATE() AND e.end_date >= CURDATE() ORDER BY e.sort_order DESC

SELECT e.id, e.poster_image AS posterImage, e.title, e.subtitle, g.name AS galleryName, e.start_date AS startDate, e.end_date AS endDate, e.type, COALESCE(e.price, 0) AS price FROM exhibition e LEFT JOIN gallery g ON e.gallery_id = g.id
e.start_date <= CURDATE() AND e.end_date >= CURDATE()
e.start_date > CURDATE()
e.end_date < CURDATE()
AND 1 = 0
AND e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND e.type = #{type}
AND g.city = #{city}
ORDER BY e.sort_order DESC, e.start_date DESC
